gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-chivo: Wobbly and blobby, Jelly Crazies draws every curve at a single stroke width with bowls nearly sealed shut, while Chivo shows daylight in each curve. Jelly Crazies is best loud and goofy; Chivo is best quiet and clear.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-chocolate-cl: Chocolate Classical Sans has a broad-nibbed stroke that never curls shut. Jelly Crazies pinches its bowls closed at stem thickness, so the body font's open, sizable lowercase feels like a breath of fresh air next to it, and it deserves generous sizing.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-comme: Playful is the first word for Jelly Crazies, whose stems and arches all share one thickness and give it a wobbly, rounded stamp. And Comme runs smoothly beneath it, with no clogged curves and lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height, so a long page would glide along.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-cossette-tex: Cossette Texte reads wide-eyed and open, with a prominent x-height. Under the closed, wobbly shapes of Jelly Crazies, a long page of it would feel steady and easy to move through, since its n arches match the stems beside them.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-duru-sans: Jelly Crazies wobbles along with nearly sealed bowls. Duru Sans then opens up wide on its small letters, its bodies dominating the line while ascenders hardly show, so a long passage would feel low and smooth after that slow, chunky heading.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-fresca: Jelly Crazies is wobbly and playful, its strokes unthinned and its bowls nearly sealed, while Fresca lets counters connect to the outside through open apertures. Jelly Crazies is best when it clowns around; Fresca is best at staying clear.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-funnel-sans: Jelly Crazies wobbles playfully, with closed bowls and no calligraphic thinning anywhere in its letters. Funnel Sans then steps in with stroke widths that hold from stem to curve and a lowercase e pried wide open, which is the pair's sharpest difference.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-gafata: Gafata stacks a tall band of lowercase under short stalks, each e wide-eyed and clear. Jelly Crazies earns its keep big and short, with contrast-free strokes and closed, wobbly letters, while Gafata handles everything that follows.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-geist: Geist keeps a quiet, level beat with no accents of weight, and its openings gape like a sprung paper clip, so words land as solid blocks. Jelly Crazies brings the wobble and closed bowls above it.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-gf-georama: Approachable describes Georama, whose wide-open c looks like a bracelet pulled apart and whose capitals barely rise. Jelly Crazies, with its hairline-free a and closed shapes, can stay big, while Georama's size is left to its own comfortable setting.
